description:
Several services together. The published starting prices of a whole event's vendors: for each service, the low, median and high published
starting price in the area, worked out for the guests and hours given, and the sum. Use it to answer "what
will a DJ, photographer and caterer cost for a 120-guest bar mitzvah in Brooklyn". For one service in
detail use get_price_summary; for actual vendors use shortlist_vendors.

area.description: Optional area: NYC (any of the five boroughs), Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island, Long Island, Westchester, North Jersey or Central Jersey, or New Jersey for both; a county or town also works (Bergen County, Hoboken, Monmouth County). Omit for the whole New York area.
area.title: Area

categories.description: The services the event needs, in plain words, e.g. ["DJ", "photographer", "caterer", "cake"]. Up to 8.
categories.title: Categories

guests.description: Number of guests. Catering and cakes, usually priced per guest, are worked out for this many.
guests.title: Guests

hours.description: Length of the event in hours. Where a service has per-hour prices, they are worked out for this long.
hours.title: Hours

metro.description: Optional metro: "Chicago" and the other metros list_categories names. Omit for New York. An area naming a metro works too.
metro.title: Metro

name: estimate_event_budget

area.description: Area the figures are for; None means the whole New York area.
area.title: Area

basis.description: How the figures were worked out, e.g. "median $40 per guest x 120 guests".
basis.title: Basis

low_usd.description: 25th percentile of published starting prices, for this event.
low_usd.title: Low Usd

vendors.description: How many vendors' published prices the figures come from.
vendors.title: Vendors

cite_as.default: Agent Bookability Index by The Runup (agentbookability.com)
cite_as.title: Cite As

sentence.description: One sentence that states the total with its source.
sentence.title: Sentence

total_high_usd.description: Sum of each service's 75th percentile: a rough high end.
total_high_usd.title: Total High Usd

total_low_usd.description: Sum of each service's 25th percentile: a rough low end, not a quote.
total_low_usd.title: Total Low Usd

title: Budget for an event
